lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity white pixel clusters are arranged in a regular, quasi-rectilinear grid posterior to the gill slits, with the blobs exhibiting a slight increase in diameter and spacing along the longitudinal axis toward the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with longitudinal carinae to create a grid-like framework; high-luminance circular blobs are positioned at these nodal intersections across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, showing a sharp vertical luminance gradient with a light upper edge and a shadowed lower margin, running parallel to the horizontal axis of the animal.

other_distinctive_markers: An elongated dark silhouette, consistent with a remora (Echeneidae), is visible swimming immediately beneath the right pectoral fin.
